mostWorthwhile.text: Building the capillary bed was most worthwhile: it showed which materials cross the thin walls and that blood cells stay inside.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the vein lining felt a little repetitive after lining the artery, even though the return direction was clear.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the picture of a contracting muscle squeezing a vein to show how the valves help blood move forward.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals explained the pairings, though fast mode offered only compatible options.

continue.text: I would probably continue: connecting the route was satisfying, and the exchange and valve pictures gave me useful things to think about, even if some fittings felt predictable.
